# Roku (ROKU) and Etsy (ETSY) Deep Dive Analysis

Report 059 | Published 2021-06-13 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2021-6-13/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/059.json)

Crypto developments and growth-stock purchases.

This article contains meaningful misses that must remain visible beside successful crypto calls. June CPI exceeded the range; Etsy failed its 20% growth premise; both selected growth stocks lost roughly 60% over five years despite Roku business expansion. BTC beat ETH over the five-year comparison. ETH worked through year-end 2021 but failed over the separate year-ahead horizon. Technical progress in Lightning and Taproot should not be counted as proof of mass payment adoption. The Roku market-cap target is closed by acquisition, with the terminal-event qualification disclosed.

**Coverage:** Read every macro, crypto, portfolio and stock-analysis block and image label. Retained distinct horizons and technical mechanisms; excluded incidental biographies and routine position sizes. Source descriptions compressed to preserve comprehensive material coverage.

European cases exceeded 7 m in first January week versus 1 m weekly in September. Omicron can reinfect previously infected people and cause severe disease; lower individual severity does not eliminate population burden.

**Deductive assessment:**

- Par bond with annual coupon 0.35% for five years; no reinvestment, taxes or deflation; cumulative inflation 5%.

Terminal nominal principal plus coupons = 1.0175; real value = 1.0175/1.05 = 0.9690 of initial purchasing power.

- [Taproot activation rules](https://bitcoincore.org/en/2021/05/01/release-0.21.1/) | Bitcoin Core | 2021-05-01 | Verified in the audit

90% of blocks in a 2016-block window signal to lock in; enforcement begins at block 709632 expected November. Mining readiness is not a poll of all users or nodes.

- [Taproot technical explanation](https://help.blockstream.com/education/development/how-bitcoin-evolves/what-is-taproot) | Blockstream | Verified in the audit

Upgrade activated November 2021. Cooperative key-path spending hides script conditions; script-path spending reveals the executed branch. Schnorr aggregation and MAST can reduce complex transaction size; not every close has identical privacy.
